title: Multiplicativity of sign encoding
statement: For $a,b\in\mathbb{F}_2$, let the sign encoding send $c\in\mathbb{F}_2$ to $(-1)^c\in\mathbb{Z}^{\times}$. Then the sign encoding of $a+b$ equals the product of the sign encodings of $a$ and $b$.
